title: Ensure Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) are encrypted
details: Tất cả 3 AMI đều có Encrypted=True (ami-0e8ae9b21ed993cb6, ami-0033a375ab8f52dab, ami-0b17c5bcd55b17b96)

title: Ensure Images (AMI) are not older than 90 days
details: Tất cả 3 AMI đều <= 90 ngày tuổi (tuổi tối đa: 28 ngày)

title: Ensure EBS volume encryption is enabled
details: Chưa bật mã hóa EBS mặc định: EbsEncryptionByDefault=False

title: Ensure Public Access to EBS Snapshots is Disabled
details: Snapshot Block Public Access đang ở trạng thái 'unblocked' (Public=0)

title: Ensure EBS volume snapshots are encrypted
details: Tất cả 3 EBS Snapshot đều có Encrypted=True (snap-0477a67c12d14ca67, snap-04003fbd64d5dca76, snap-0e52cef71fd051a00)

title: Ensure ECS task definitions using 'host' network mode do not allow privileged/root
details: Tất cả Task Definition (cis-compute-benchmark-task:5) không vi phạm host network + root/privileged.

title: Ensure 'assignPublicIp' is set to 'DISABLED' for Amazon ECS services
details: ECS Service đang cấu hình assignPublicIp='ENABLED': cis-compute-benchmark-service

title: Ensure Amazon ECS task definitions do not have 'pidMode' set to 'host'
details: Không có Task Definition nào đặt pidMode='host' (cis-compute-benchmark-task:5).

title: Ensure Amazon ECS task definitions do not have 'privileged' set to 'true'
details: Tất cả container trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:5) đều đặt privileged=False.

title: Ensure 'readonlyRootFilesystem' is set to 'true' for Amazon ECS task definitions
details: Container chưa bật readonlyRootFilesystem=True (cis-compute-benchmark-task:5)

title: Ensure secrets are not passed as container environment variables in ECS task definitions
details: Không có biến môi trường chứa secret plaintext trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:5).

title: Ensure logging is configured for Amazon ECS task definitions
details: Tất cả container trong (cis-compute-benchmark-task:5) đã bật logDriver='awslogs'.

title: Ensure Amazon ECS Fargate services are using the latest Fargate platform version
details: Fargate Service đang dùng Platform Version mới nhất: cis-compute-benchmark-service(LATEST)

title: Ensure monitoring is enabled for Amazon ECS clusters
details: ECS Cluster chưa bật Container Insights: cis-compute-benchmark-cluster (containerInsights=disabled)

title: Ensure Amazon ECS services are tagged
details: Tất cả ECS Service đều đã gắn thẻ quản lý: cis-compute-benchmark-service (3 tags)

title: Ensure Amazon ECS clusters are tagged
details: Tất cả ECS Cluster đều đã gắn thẻ quản lý: cis-compute-benchmark-cluster (3 tags)

title: Ensure Amazon ECS task definitions are tagged
details: Tất cả Task Definition đều đã gắn thẻ: cis-compute-benchmark-task:5 (3 tags)

title: Ensure only trusted images are used with Amazon ECS
details: Chỉ sử dụng container image từ kho ECR nội bộ đáng tin cậy: cis-compute-benchmark-task:5 (cis-compute-benchmark-private-repo:latest)

title: Ensure 'assignPublicIp' is set to 'DISABLED' for Amazon ECS task sets
details: ECS Task Set đang đặt assignPublicIp='ENABLED' (cis-compute-benchmark-service/primary-taskset)

title: Ensure customer-managed keys are used to encrypt AWS Fargate ephemeral storage data
details: Fargate Ephemeral Storage chưa mã hóa bằng KMS CMK trên cluster: cis-compute-benchmark-cluster

title: Ensure AWS Lambda Function URLs are configured to use AWS IAM authentication
details: Lambda Function URL đang mở công khai không xác thực: cis-compute-benchmark-lambda(AuthType=NONE)
